text: わたしも　あんな　エスパー　しょうじょに　なりたいの！

structure.jp: あんな　エスパー　しょうじょに

structure.en: I want to become, you see!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end makes the sentence an explanation of herself; this bare の is how girls and women often say it. なりたいの = 'it's that I want to become one'

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: しょうじょに　なりたい
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what someone turns into. しょうじょに　なりたい = 'want to become a girl' (a Psychic girl)

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. なりたい = 'I want to become'
